name: Financing Item List 1
definition: Specifies a list of financing items exchanged between two parties, for example invoice, credit, financing request.

Identifier.name: Identifier
Identifier.definition: Identification assigned to unambiguously identify the financing item list.

IssueDate.name: Issue Date
IssueDate.definition: Date of creation of this document.

RelatedDocument.name: Related Document
RelatedDocument.definition: Reference to related documents for example to original assignment in a status response or retry.

AmountCutOffDate.name: Amount Cut Off Date
AmountCutOffDate.definition: Cut off date for items used to establish the total request amount.

Assignee.name: Assignee
Assignee.definition: Party to which the list is assigned.

NotificationInformation.name: Notification Information
NotificationInformation.definition: Identifies parties that notify the assignment(s) and the notified parties.

ItemCount.name: Item Count
ItemCount.definition: Number of individual items contained in the list.

ControlSum.name: Control Sum
ControlSum.definition: Total of all individual amounts included in the list, irrespective of currencies.

TotalRequestAmount.name: Total Request Amount
TotalRequestAmount.definition: Total amount in all items. Requires same currency, necessary when financing request is in percentage.

AgreedRate.name: Agreed Rate
AgreedRate.definition: Acceptable exchange rate for financing by different currency.

AdditionalInformation.name: Additional Information
AdditionalInformation.definition: Additional free form information concerning the list.

FinancingStatus.name: Financing Status
FinancingStatus.definition: Financing status if applicable to the nature of the items.
